overview_description.description: DeepReach is a platform that enables entrepreneurs around the world to build independent local data businesses serving Physical AI. The company provides wearable hardware, software, quality infrastructure, customer demand, and operational support, while entrepreneurs recruit local experts and expand access to diverse real-world environments. Together, these businesses create scalable, high-quality real-world data for robot foundation models, world models, and other AI systems.
